title: Virtual Care Encounters Converted to In-Person Visits: Credit and Window
content:
When the clinician converts a Virtual Care encounter to an in-person visit, the patient is not charged the self-pay price or virtual copay beyond the visit type's conversion credit share credited toward the in-person visit.

## Policy

1. **Conversion.** A conversion is the clinician's determination that the problem needs an in-person examination, ending the virtual encounter. The date the virtual encounter is closed as converted is the conversion date. The in-person visit is the In-Person Appointment booked for the conversion, recorded on the virtual encounter.
2. **Credit.** When the clinician converts a virtual encounter to an in-person visit, the patient is not charged the self-pay price or virtual copay beyond the visit type's conversion credit share credited toward the in-person visit.
3. **Window.** The in-person visit takes place no later than the visit type's conversion window counted from the conversion date. The window is counted in calendar days starting the day after the conversion date, and a visit on the last day still qualifies.
4. **Past the window.** Past the window the credit is refunded instead of applied.
5. **Share of 0.** Where the conversion credit share is 0 (behavioral health), the virtual encounter is charged as completed and nothing is credited.

The conversion date is read from the system's record of the virtual encounter.

## The window restated

The last qualifying day is the calendar date that falls the window's number of days after the conversion date. An in-person visit on that date qualifies; an in-person visit on the following date does not.

## Calendar cases (hypothetical conversion dates and windows)

| Conversion date | Hypothetical window | First day counted | Last qualifying day | In-person visit on | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 10 March | 7 days | 11 March | 17 March | 17 March | Within the window; credit applied |
| 10 March | 7 days | 11 March | 17 March | 18 March | Past the window; credit refunded instead |
| 30 April | 3 days | 1 May | 3 May | 3 May | Within the window; credit applied |
| 30 April | 3 days | 1 May | 3 May | 4 May | Past the window; credit refunded instead |

## Credit cases (hypothetical patient charges)

- Hypothetical patient charge $80.00, conversion credit share 100 percent, in-person visit within the window: $80.00 is credited toward the in-person visit and nothing beyond it is charged for the virtual encounter.
- Hypothetical patient charge $80.00, conversion credit share 50 percent, in-person visit within the window: $40.00 is credited toward the in-person visit.
- Conversion credit share 0 percent: the virtual encounter is charged as completed and nothing is credited.
